tools.name: Items

response.name: Haagen-Dazs New York Strawberry Cheesecake Ice Cream (14 fl oz)

sections.text: New York strawberry cheesecake ice cream - velvety cheesecake ice cream swirled with strawberry sauce and soft graham cracker crust pieces. Made with real milk, cream, eggs, strawberry sauce, and graham cracker crust pieces - familiar ingredients, thoughtfully brought together for a cheesecake experience that feels just right. Just rich, smooth, creamy ice cream, unmistakably Häagen-Dazs. In a world that tells you to move faster, this is your moment to slow down. Take your sweet time and savor every spoonful - the strawberry swirl, the cheesecake creaminess, the graham cracker crunch, the experience of ice cream made to be savored, not rushed. Kosher, crafted with thoughtfully selected ingredients, it's indulgence without compromise. Häagen-Dazs is crafted for those who believe indulgence should be felt, not rushed. That's Dazs.

reviews.text:
I recently indulged in the cheesecake-flavored ice cream from Haagen Dazs, and it was a delightfully creamy experience that truly lived up to its promise. The flavor is a perfect blend of the rich, tangy taste of traditional cheesecake paired with the cool, soothing texture of ice cream. Every spoonful was thick and luscious, with a consistency that melted smoothly in the mouth, reminiscent of the dense filling of a classic cheesecake.

What really sets this ice cream apart is how it captures the essence of cheesecake, complete with a subtle hint of a graham cracker base. The balance between sweetness and tanginess is impeccable, making it not just refreshing, but also satisfying for any dessert lover. It's perfect for those who adore cheesecake but crave the chilled comfort of ice cream.
reviews.title: Delicious!

reviews.text: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This ice cream was rich and delicious! With plenty of graham cracker pieces, swirls of strawberry sauce and cheese cake flavored ice cream, this product really hit the spot. I can always count on Haagen-Dazs to have the creamiest of ice cream and the sweetest of toppings and this time did not disappoint. This flavor had everything you think of when you bite into a slice of New York cheesecake. I would recommend this to anyone who likes strawberry desserts and a rich ice cream. I’ll definitely be buying this again in the near future.
reviews.title: Rich and creamy!

reviews.text: I was craving a good ice cream and this tub made my day. The flavor is amazingly delicious with a perfect balance of strawberry swirl and cheesecake. There are tiny pieces of cheesecake in it which adds a nice texture. I am totally impressed by this ice cream.
reviews.title: Very delicious

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Find stores and restaurants near a latitude/longitude for a query. Use search_items to search products inside one store.

options.name: max_pages
options.about: Maximum source pages fetched in this call. Cursors stay inside the call.

options.name: query
options.about: Search text; leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed. No control characters.

response.about: Search DoorDash US stores and restaurants near explicit latitude/longitude coordinates. Returns ranked store results with IDs, URLs, ratings and availability; optional pagination stays within the call.

tools.name: Search items

options.name: limit
options.about: Requested items per source page. DoorDash may return fewer.

options.name: max_pages
options.about: Maximum source pages fetched in this call. Cursors stay inside the call.

options.name: query
options.about: Search text; leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed. No control characters.
